Hi Megan — quick heads up on SSO and onboarding windows: we typically require a block of three consecutive business days for initial integration validation (test IdP, cert rotation, and sample API traffic). If you want a condensed two-week ramp, we’ll map tasks across teams during the MSA call and confirm owners.

Agenda suggestion for the 12/14 call (45 min):
1) Legal walkthrough of redlines (Rishi) — 20m
2) Onboarding prerequisites and timeline decision (Vanessa) — 15m
3) Action list and DocuSign timeline (Kimberly) — 10m

If the legal team has any high-priority dealbreakers, flag them up front and we’ll extend.

— Vanessa
Vanessa Ortiz
Partner Success Manager, Redwood Inference

On Tue, Dec 14, 2026 at 10:00 AM Avery Systems wrote:
> [calendar invite] Master Agreement working session — 45 minutes

Thanks everyone for a productive session — notes below and next steps.

Summary:
- Retention: agreed to a 90-day default for transient logs with an optional enterprise retention addendum. Action: Avery to confirm use cases that need longer retention (Megan).
- Incident response: Redlined timeline moved from 48 -> 72 hours for initial acknowledgement; Redwood to add an escalation path for regulatory incidents. Action: Rishi will add explicit escalation contacts.
- SSO/onboarding: Vanessa to propose a 3-day validation window as standard; Avery requested a 10-business-day pilot. Action: Vanessa/Marissa to align on a condensed plan and record owners in ONB-5543.

Deliverables:
1) Redwood to circulate MSA clean copy reflecting agreed edits by 12/17.
2) Avery to confirm any extended retention needs by 12/18.
3) DocuSign target: 12/20 pending approvals.

If anything above is off, please reply-all with corrections.

— Rishi
Rishi Malhotra
Legal Counsel, Redwood Inference
